set.body:
Journey: Bring in. Track: console.

Outcome
A curator opens the link the import command printed and reviews the candidate as they would an upload.

Acceptance
1. The console has a candidate review page reachable by link: what was added, coverage by data type, findings, and Accept. It reuses the upload preview.
2. A curator without permission to accept sees the preview and a clear statement of who can accept.
3. A candidate that was superseded or already accepted says so and links to the current release.
4. The dataset's page shows that a candidate is waiting for review.

Start from
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/upload.js: the preview.
- modules/http/src/main/scala/sanctity/http/RepositoryHttp.scala lines 218 to 220: read and accept a candidate.

Evidence
A console check, and the browser step in IN6.
set.title: IN7: Review a server-side import in the browser
